from pysat.solvers import Cadical153
from pysat.card import CardEnc, EncType
from pysat.formula import IDPool

N = 50
W = 7
G = 10
S = 5

vpool = IDPool()
def x(w,p,g): return vpool.id(('x',w,p,g))
def t(w,p,q,g): return vpool.id(('t',w,p,q,g))  # p<q together in week w in group g

solver = Cadical153()

# Each player in exactly one group each week
for w in range(W):
    for p in range(N):
        lits = [x(w,p,g) for g in range(G)]
        # exactly one
        cnf = CardEnc.equals(lits=lits, bound=1, vpool=vpool, encoding=EncType.pairwise)
        for c in cnf.clauses: solver.add_clause(c)

# Each group has exactly 5 players each week
for w in range(W):
    for g in range(G):
        lits = [x(w,p,g) for p in range(N)]
        cnf = CardEnc.equals(lits=lits, bound=S, vpool=vpool, encoding=EncType.seqcounter)
        for c in cnf.clauses: solver.add_clause(c)

# Symmetry breaking week 1: players 0..4 in group 0, 5..9 in group 1, ...
for p in range(N):
    solver.add_clause([x(0, p, p//5)])

# Symmetry breaking: player 0 in group 0 every week
for w in range(W):
    solver.add_clause([x(w, 0, 0)])

# Pair constraints: use auxiliary pair-week vars

# Use z[w,p,q,g] = x[w,p,g] AND x[w,q,g]. Then sum_{w,g} z <= 1.

# Then AtMost1(z over w,g) forces at most one co-group event.

def z(w,p,q,g): return vpool.id(('z',w,p,q,g))

import random

def try_build(seed):
    random.seed(seed)
    N = 50
    W = 7
    G = 10
    S = 5
    # forbidden[p] = set of players p has played with
    played = [set() for _ in range(N)]
    schedule = []  # schedule[w][g] = list of players
    
    def solve_week(w, groups, remaining):
        # groups is list of current partial groups; remaining is set of unassigned players
        # find next group to fill
        # Find first group not full
        for gi in range(G):
            if len(groups[gi]) < S:
                # try adding a player
                # pick a player from remaining
                # heuristic: pick player with fewest compatible remaining options? just try
                if len(groups[gi]) == 0:
                    # must add a player; pick smallest remaining for symmetry
                    p = min(remaining)
                    groups[gi].append(p)
                    remaining.remove(p)
                    r = solve_week(w, groups, remaining)
                    if r: return True
                    remaining.add(p)
                    groups[gi].pop()
                    return False
                else:
                    # candidates: players in remaining not played with anyone in groups[gi]
                    cands = [p for p in remaining if all(q not in played[p] for q in groups[gi])]
                    random.shuffle(cands)
                    for p in cands:
                        groups[gi].append(p)
                        remaining.remove(p)
                        r = solve_week(w, groups, remaining)
                        if r: return True
                        remaining.add(p)
                        groups[gi].pop()
                    return False
        # all groups full

    for w in range(W):

            if not solve_week(w, groups, remaining):

        schedule.append(groups)
        # update played

                    played[a].add(b)
